name: Stability
overview: Scripture reveals that true stability is rooted in a heart firmly fixed on God, as expressed in the Psalms where the believer’s heart is steadfast and prepared to praise. This inner stability is characterized by trust in the Lord, which removes fear even in the face of adversity. The New Testament reinforces this by teaching that enduring faithfully to the end, despite opposition and hatred, leads to salvation. Moreover, stability in character is demonstrated by those who receive God's word and bear fruit abundantly, showing the transformative power of a steadfast faith.
